summary: Frontend E2E (pro user, 390x844 + 1920x1080) of the new Arrival check, the green ticked-row style and a Leaving the Dock regression check. Everything in the request works: arrival-check sits above the list in Arriving at Destination and Returning to Dock and is not on other lists; arrival-no-departure note shows; the five level buttons work for fuel/gas/water and each battery, with red warnings at 1/4 and Empty; 'about X L left' details are correct; arrival-spares inputs default to the full count and are capped at the max. Usage maths checked against the spec example (60 L tank + 2x20 L cans, depart 1/2 -> 70 L; arrive 1/4 with 1 can -> 35 L left, used about 35 L, planned about 15 L, actual 7 L/h vs 3 L/h; water used 50 L; gas used 2.3 kg; a higher fuel level reads 'topped up about 30 L on the way'). The log checkbox stays disabled until every level is picked. Ticking adds 'Arrival check (Arriving at Destination) <date>: ...' to the Ship's Log with the toast; arrival-log-outdated / arrival-relog-btn update the same item; unticking removes it; New arrival clears. boat.arrive survives a reload. Departure regression passed: Magic Mariner calc, overrides, ack, log, outdated, relog, toast. Ticked rows: background #dcfce7, green inset edge, no line-through, Done badge with icon, all removed on untick. Crew Roles picks are still blue with no badge. Cocktail rows turn green. Found 4 minor issues and no critical ones.

ui_bugs.issue: boat.arrive is shared by Arriving at Destination and Returning to Dock, but log_sig includes listName. After logging from Arriving at Destination, opening Returning to Dock straight away shows 'Changed since it was copied' (arrival-log-outdated) even though nothing changed. Pressing Update there also renames the log entry to '(Returning to Dock)'.
Updating the arrival entry shows the toast 'Ship's Log departure entry updated'. It should say arrival (pass kind into relog the same way logDeparture gets it).

.checklist-row.is-checked:not(.is-pick) (specificity 0,3,0) beats .checklist-row.is-flagged (0,2,0). A ticked row that is also flagged loses its red background and edge: it shows green with red text and the red flag icon. Untick and it looks flagged again. Decide if this is intended.

When a departure exists but no arrival level has been picked yet (e.g. after New arrival), arrival-used reads 'not known (no departure level)'. The departure level is there; it is the arrival level that is missing.

issues: The LevelPicker warning reads 'Top up or charge before you leave.' on the arrival check too, which is wrong after arriving
The fuel 1/3rd rule hint shows on the arrival fuel row, where it doesn't help
Before a level is picked, water and gas details already show 'about 20 L left' / 'about 4.5 kg left' from the spare cans alone

action_items: Leave listName out of the arrival log_sig (or keep the sig independent of the list) so the other list doesn't falsely show outdated; consider keeping the original list name when relogging
Pass kind into relogDeparture so the arrival toast says 'arrival entry updated'
Optional: make flagged+ticked rows keep a red cue (e.g. .checklist-row.is-checked.is-flagged rule)
Optional: arrival-specific warning text, hide the 1/3 hint on arrival, and use 'not known (no arrival level)' when only the arrival level is missing
critical_code_review_comments: ArrivalCheck stores the full summary text in arrive.log_sig (about 500 chars). That fits under the 12000 limit, but a short hash would be leaner (the same applies to departure)
Cocktail tick box stays navy while the row turns green: a small visual mismatch with the green tick-box on checklists

success_rate.backend: n/a (frontend only; arrive persisted via PUT, checked after reload)
